items.author: Trump
items.text: Ukraine has agreed not to hit Russian Energy targets. Russia has agreed to do, likewise! The World’s Diesel price rise is mostly caused by the Russia/Ukraine War, not Iran. President DJT
items.summary_cn: 特朗普称乌俄已同意互不攻击对方能源目标，并指世界柴油价格上涨主要由俄乌战争而非伊朗冲突造成。

items.author: Trump
items.text: I hope everyone realizes that price increases throughout America were caused by Sleepy Joe Biden and the Biden Administration, not by “TRUMP.” Even Oil was higher under Biden than it is right now, and we prevented Iran from having a Nuclear Weapon! With the temporary exception of Oil, prices are coming down sharply, and Oil will drop like a rock as soon as the Military Conflict with Iran is over, and that will not be long. Thank you for your attention to this matter! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: 特朗普称物价上涨怪拜登而非自己，并预期与伊朗军事冲突结束后油价将'像石头一样下跌'，暗示油价短期承压。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Oil is flowing through the Hormuz Strait. The Countries of the World, which have been no help to us whatsoever, should, and will, reimburse the United States of America when this SCAM Confligration is all over. We are doing it much more for others, than we are for ourselves, and we have been for Generations! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: 特朗普称石油正在通过霍尔木兹海峡，要求各国'报销'美国军事行动费用，暗示中东局势仍主导油价。

items.author: 段永平
items.text: 清倉神華 段永平怎麼想？|香港經濟日報
items.summary_cn: 据港媒报道，段永平清仓中国神华(港股01088)，对传统能源/煤炭板块态度转空，与kcn持有的金风科技(02208)同属能源板块但为新能源对立面。

items.author: Trump
items.text: The only reason the AI/Data Center outburst is happening is because the United States is leading, by a lot, every other country. Don’t kill the Golden Goose! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: 特朗普为AI/数据中心扩张辩护，称反对是因为美国'大幅领先其他国家'，警告'别杀金鹅'，明确反对限制AI/数据中心政策。

items.author: Trump
items.text: I’ve just received a Report that the United States is producing more Exquisite and Elite Weapons than at any time in our History. They are being delivered on a daily basis to our Forces in the Middle East, and beyond. Our Defense Company Factories are moving 24/7, while at the same time building, on average, 4 to 5 largescale brand new Plants, each! A primary focus of this production has been Patriots, THAAD Systems, Tomahawks, and other Standard Missile Systems, of which we already have large numbers in stock. President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: 特朗普称美国国防工厂24/7运转、每家新建4-5座大型工厂，重点生产Patriot、THAAD、Tomahawk导弹系统，利好国防军工板块。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Concerning AI, when, in the History of Business, did anyone see the Leaders of an Industry call for Regulation that, if strongly implemented, will drive them into oblivion and bankruptcy? AI taking over the World, destroying Humanity, and all other things bad, is a HOAX, no different from RUSSIA, RUSSIA, RUSSIA — UKRAINE, UKRAINE, UKRAINE — IMPEACHMENT HOAX #1 — IMPEACHMENT HOAX #2 — and all of the other HOAXES and SCAMS that America was forced to endure through the Destructionists’ and Deviants’ foul play and illegal conduct. President Xi, of China, just announced that China will be doing abs
items.summary_cn: 特朗普明确反对AI行业自我监管，称严格监管将'驱使行业走向毁灭'，与习近平监管表态形成对照。

items.author: Burry
items.text: 'Big Short' Michael Burry says AI leaders' calls for slowdown are 'self-serving' and he's not worried
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Michael Burry称AI领军企业呼吁放慢AI发展是'自私的'，他本人对此并不担忧，立场偏看多AI。

items.author: Burry
items.text: ‘Big Short’ trader Michael Burry slams OpenAI, Anthropic for ‘self-serving’ calls to slow AI – joining backlash
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Michael Burry抨击OpenAI、Anthropic呼吁放慢AI发展是'自私的'，加入反对AI放缓的舆论阵营。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk: I've been 'sounding the alarm' on AI for a while
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Musk称自己'一直在就AI发出警告'，延续其AI风险叙事（与特朗普的反AI恐慌立场相左）。

items.author: Trump
items.text: The people that say AI is going to destroy the World, and that Data Centers are bad for your neighborhood, are the same people that said, just a short time ago, that the World would be extinguished by “Climate Change.” That HOAX never worked out for them, and now they’re on to the next one. These people are Revolutionaries, but Revolutionaries for a Bad and Evil Cause. Soon you’ll find out they’re working for people that do not have the best interests of the United States in mind! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: 特朗普抨击警告AI/数据中心危害的人是'为邪恶事业服务的革命者'，反对限制AI发展。

items.author: 洪灏
items.text: 【金價走勢】花旗料金價重返5000美元潛在升幅15% 高盛籲4000美元收集迎新牛市
items.summary_cn: 据报道，洪灝转述花旗看金价重返5000美元(潜在升幅15%)、高盛建议4000美元收集迎新牛市，大行集体看多黄金。

items.author: Trump
items.text: The claim that “AI is going to take over the World” is a Hoax, just like Global “Warming,” where everyone was going to be dead by now, RUSSIA, RUSSIA, RUSSIA, UKRAINE, UKRAINE, UKRAINE, or Impeachment Hoax #1, or Impeachment Hoax #2. These are all Radical Left Dumocrats, who never give up, but seldom win. Hopefully, the Voters have seen the light! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: 特朗普称'AI将接管世界'是骗局，与'全球变暖骗局'相提并论，对AI恐慌叙事进行抨击。

items.author: Trump
items.text: The failing Nation of Iran wants to make a deal, quickly and badly. I will determine whether or not the U.S.A. will choose to engage - The concept of which we are open to. Thank you for your attention to this matter! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: 特朗普称'失败的伊朗想快速达成协议'，美国对是否接触持开放态度，伊朗局势或迎来缓和窗口。

items.author: Burry
items.text: Michael Burry calls AI leaders’ slowdown push ‘self-serving’ (OPENAI:Private)
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Michael Burry抨击AI企业放缓AI的呼吁是'自私的'(针对未上市的OpenAI)。

items.author: 洪灏
items.text: AI | 洪灝：達里奧重拳砸盤；AI發展的全新階段
items.summary_cn: 据报道，洪灝评论达里奥'重拳砸盘'及AI发展进入新阶段，宏观AI双线讨论。

items.author: Trump
items.text: I am the Hoax Buster, and I’m right now breaking another Hoax — That AI is going to take over, consume, and destroy the World, and that Robots will be marching into our Cities, and getting rid of us all! This is even wilder than the RUSSIA, RUSSIA, RUSSIA HOAX, or the Global Warming Scam. Thank you for your attention to this matter! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: 特朗普自称'Hoax Buster'，抨击AI接管世界、机器人威胁人类的论调是骗局。
